Windows Calculator's CalcManager, vendored for NovaOS
=====================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/calculator, commit
d125246a4e19842ce1332e6c7839cf0e110027d8 (2026-09-28).
Kept, unchanged: src/CalcManager (the calculation engine: Ratpack's
rational arithmetic, CCalcEngine, CalculatorManager, history and the
unit converter, without ratpak.natvis) as CalcManager/, the en-US engine
strings src/Calculator/Resources/en-US/CEngineStrings.resw as
Resources/en-US/, and LICENSE.

userland/programs/calc.cpp (calc.exe) compiles CEngine/, Ratpack/,
CalculatorHistory.cpp, CalculatorManager.cpp and ExpressionCommand.cpp
into itself with Microsoft's STL, as CalcManager.vcxproj does (pch.h
forced in, src/ on the include path); see "sources" in
userland/programs/calc.json.  Its string table is the en-US .resw's.
UnitConverter.cpp is not built yet: it needs the Concurrency Runtime's
task<> (<ppltasks.h>) beyond NovaOS's stand-in, and its unit data lives in
the app's C# view models.

To update: copy src/CalcManager and the .resw from a newer commit, then
rebuild calc.exe.

Licence: MIT (LICENSE).
